# Introduction {#introduction}

## Extension Overview

This extension adds a **premium**, **interactive** progress indicator to your Quarto presentations.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Native Implementation
Built fully native as a **Quarto Lua Filter** — zero external dependencies required.
:::

## Key Features

1. **Section Grouping**: Group slides neatly under section headers.
2. **Single-Slide Sections**: Seamless handling for single-slide sections (e.g. *References*, *Thank You*).
3. **Auto-hide & Idle Fade**: Fades out automatically when presentation is idle.
4. **Theme Inheritance**: Automatically adopts accent colors from your Reveal.js theme.

# Themes & Styling {#themes}

## Color Palettes

Choose from **8 built-in palettes** (4 light, 4 dark) or customize your own:

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Light Themes**

- 🌊 **Ocean** — Deep Blue
- 🌿 **Emerald** — Muted Green
- 🌅 **Sunset** — Warm Orange
- 💜 **Lavender** — Soft Purple
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Dark Themes**

- 🧛 **Dracula** — Purple Night
- ❄️ **Nord** — Arctic Blue
- 🌻 **Gruvbox** — Warm Dark
- 🌙 **Tokyo Night** — Neon Blue
:::
:::

## Custom Color Persistence

All visual settings persist across page reloads via `localStorage`:

- Active dot color
- Inactive dot color
- Section label color
- Background blur & opacity

# Settings & Controls {#settings}

## Interactive Menu (<kbd>i</kbd>)

Press <kbd>i</kbd> at any time to open the **Live Settings Panel**:

- Change position (**Top** / **Bottom**)
- Change progress style (**Dots** / **Progress Bar**)
- Toggle tooltips & active animations
- Manage per-slide dot & bar visibility

## Useful Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
| :---: | :--- |
| <kbd>i</kbd> | Open / Close Settings Panel |
| <kbd>x</kbd> | Toggle Progress Indicator Visibility |
